public.title: Same Tree
public.description: Return whether two binary trees have the same shape and equal values at corresponding nodes. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: Compare both children only after the current values agree.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Recursively compare matching nodes, treating two empty positions as equal. O(n+m) worst-case time and O(h) call space.
